tests.name: 4933正邪按战斗开始面板决定，双攻相等两条件皆不触发，当前自身信仰可阻止狂信改指敌方
tests.assertion: test('4933正邪按战斗开始面板决定，双攻相等两条件皆不触发，当前自身信仰可阻止狂信改指敌方',()=>{for(const [atk,spa,form]of[[200,100,'positive'],[100,200,'evil'],[100,100,null]]){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk,spa}});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.form,form);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].statusState?.faithSourceSide,form?0:undefined);s.fighters[0].ailments['狂信']=5;turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(29425)],4);}});

tests.name: 4933正气回合初消费意念实际魂印回复，不受技能禁疗、受一般回复削减且满血仍消耗
tests.assertion: test('4933正气回合初消费意念实际魂印回复，不受技能禁疗、受一般回复削减且满血仍消耗',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','skillBan','cut','full']){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},hp:mode==='full'?9000:1000});s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought=300;if(mode==='skillBan')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='cut')timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='full'?9000:mode==='cut'?1150:1300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought,0);}});

tests.name: 4933邪气消耗意念为下一次攻击固定附伤，属性与药剂不消费，免固仍消费一次
tests.assertion: test('4933邪气消耗意念为下一次攻击固定附伤，属性与药剂不消费，免固仍消费一次',()=>{for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:100,spa:200}});s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought=300;turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.extra,300);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.extra,300);s.moveDefinitions[key(38494)].operations=[];if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s,38494,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),immune?0:300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.extra,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought,0);}});

tests.name: 4933单个当前信仰者HP比例分档增伤减伤有真实状态，未知意念增量单独阻塞不得伪造
tests.assertion: test('4933单个当前信仰者HP比例分档增伤减伤有真实状态，未知意念增量单独阻塞不得伪造',()=>{const reduced=[];for(const hp of[9000,4499]){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,hp,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100}});withoutUnconfirmedAccounting(()=>turn(s,29425,10127));reduced.push(sum(s,'attack',1));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,hp-reduced.at(-1));}assert.ok(reduced[0]<reduced[1]);const damages=[];for(const hp of[9000,4499]){const s=make({move:38494,index:-1,soul:true,hp,aStats:{atk:100,spa:200}});withoutUnconfirmedAccounting(()=>turn(s,38494,20309));damages.push(sum(s));}assert.ok(damages[1]>damages[0]);const p=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100}});assert.throws(()=>turn(p,29425,10127),/Q-4933-002/);assert.equal(p.round,1);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].hp,9000);});

tests.name: 4933双方信仰合计、意念不减与未消费附伤再授各明确待答，事务回滚保留前态
tests.assertion: test('4933双方信仰合计、意念不减与未消费附伤再授各明确待答，事务回滚保留前态',()=>{for(const mode of['two','freeze','extra']){const s=make({move:38494,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:100,spa:200}}),st=s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128;if(mode==='two')s.fighters[1].statusState={faithSourceSide:0};else st.thought=100;if(mode==='freeze')timer(s,0,'修罗意念不减');if(mode==='extra')st.extra=200;assert.throws(()=>turn(s,38494,20117),new RegExp('Q-4933-00'+({two:1,freeze:3,extra:4}[mode])));assert.equal(s.round,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38494)],5);}});

tests.assertion: test('4933五招各64种子原生全效果链真实伤害和PP，双攻相等魂印无正邪状态分支',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.id===38493?5:4);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));if(m.kind!=='status')assert.ok(sum(s)>0);if(m.id===29426)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,2);if(m.id===29425)assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']);}for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.form,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought,0);}});

tests.assertion: test('4933/191真实异常反弹，936疲惫失败封属性，2028天敌必中越过闪避',()=>{const s=make(row(191));observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']);for(const immune of[false,true]){const p=make(row(936));if(immune)p.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(p,p.auditMoveId,20117);assert.equal(!!p.fighters[1].ailments['疲惫'],!immune);assert.equal(p.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);}const p=make({...row(2028),hit:false});p.fighters[1].type='草';assert.ok(E.typeEffectiveness(p.fighters[0].type,p.fighters[1].type,p.typeChart)>1);timer(p,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});turn(p,p.auditMoveId,20117);assert.ok(sum(p)>0);});

tests.assertion: test('4933/191真实异常反弹，936疲惫失败封属性，2028天敌必中越过闪避',()=>{const s=make(row(191));observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']);for(const immune of[false,true]){const p=make(row(936));if(immune)p.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(p,p.auditMoveId,20117);assert.equal(!!p.fighters[1].ailments['疲惫'],!immune);assert.equal(p.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);}const p=make({...row(2028),hit:false});p.fighters[1].type='草';assert.ok(E.typeEffectiveness(p.fighters[0].type,p.fighters[1].type,p.typeChart)>1);timer(p,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});turn(p,p.auditMoveId,20117);assert.ok(sum(p)>0);});

tests.assertion: test('4933/835反转自己负级成功技能回满，1771反转敌正级并禁止解除反转三回，1821未击败全PP回5',()=>{const s=make({...row(835),hp:1000});s.fighters[0].stages.atk=-2;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);const p=make(row(1771));p.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;turn(p,p.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(p.fighters[1].stages.atk,-2);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.clearNegative(c.a);},()=>turn(p,p.auditMoveId,20309));assert.equal(p.fighters[1].stages.atk,-2);for(const hp of[1,9000]){const q=make({...row(1821),targetHp:hp});for(const k of q.fighters[0].moves)q.fighters[0].pp[k]=2;turn(q,q.auditMoveId,20117);assert.equal(q.fighters[0].pp[key(29425)],hp===1?2:5);}});

tests.assertion: test('4933五招各64种子原生全效果链真实伤害和PP，双攻相等魂印无正邪状态分支',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.id===38493?5:4);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));if(m.kind!=='status')assert.ok(sum(s)>0);if(m.id===29426)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,2);if(m.id===29425)assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']);}for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.form,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought,0);}});

tests.assertion: test('4933/2554复用已确认双攻先相加再按本次攻击等级修正，物特攻正零负等级与等效面板相同',()=>{for(const move of[38492,38493,38494])for(const stage of[-6,-2,0,2,6]){const stat=move===38493?'spa':'atk',other=stat==='atk'?'spa':'atk',s=make({move,index:0,aStats:{atk:200,spa:300}}),b=make({move,index:-1,aStats:{atk:500,spa:500}});s.fighters[0].stages[stat]=stage;b.fighters[0].stages[stat]=stage;s.fighters[0].stages[other]=-stage;turn(s,move,20309);turn(b,move,20309);assert.equal(sum(s),sum(b));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages[stat],stage);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages[other],-stage||0);}});

tests.assertion: test('4933/2498清回合成功依失败异常数当次红伤倍增，免异不补抽，无回合不发动',()=>{const damage=[];for(const immune of[0,1,2]){const s=make(row(2498));s.fighters[1].counts.immune=immune;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);damage.push(sum(s));assert.equal(Number(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['束缚'])+Number(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['臣服']),2-immune);}for(const [i,multiple]of[[1,2],[2,4]]){assert.ok(damage[i]>=Math.floor(damage[0]*multiple*.85)-2);assert.ok(damage[i]<=Math.ceil(damage[0]*multiple/.85)+2);}const s=make(row(2498));s.fighters[1].effects={};turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['束缚'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['臣服'],undefined);});
